breakdown.description: When a specimen is weighed while immersed, buoyancy reduces the apparent weight, so the immersed mass should be smaller than the saturated-in-air mass, not larger.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification keeps immersed mass at 13.6 g, which is larger than the saturated mass 13.1 g, repeating the original physical inconsistency. The ground truth corrects this by using an immersed mass of 8.6 g (smaller than saturated mass), consistent with buoyancy.
